user_query.title: Schedule 1-hour team planning meeting from ICS calendars
user_query.text: Find the earliest valid 1-hour meeting slot for Alice, Bob, and Carol during January 15-19, 2024, business hours 9 AM-6 PM Monday-Friday, that satisfies their availability constraints and avoids existing calendar conflicts. Alice prefers 9 AM-12 PM and can do 12-2 PM if needed, but absolutely no meetings after 2 PM or before 9 AM. Bob prefers 1-5 PM, can do 11 AM-1 PM if needed, must leave by 4:30 PM on Tue/Thu, and has no meetings before 10 AM. Carol is available 9 AM-5 PM, unavailable 12:00-12:30 PM for lunch, prefers not to meet on Mondays, and needs a 15-minute buffer after meetings ending at 4:45 PM or later. Read the three input ICS files at /app/alice_calendar.ics, /app/bob_calendar.ics, and /app/carol_calendar.ics without modifying them. Create /app/meeting_scheduled.ics containing a valid ICS file with BEGIN:VCALENDAR and END:VCALENDAR, VERSION:2.0 and PRODID headers, and a VEVENT for a 1-hour Team Planning Meeting including alice@example.com, bob@example.com, and carol@example.com. Use UTC times in YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ format, assume local time is UTC, and evaluate earliest valid slot at minute granularity. Use Carol's Monday avoidance and Alice's morning preference as tie-breakers when multiple valid slots exist; Bob's afternoon preference is informational only.

events.thought:
Analysis: I have all calendar data. Combined hard constraints: Alice requires end <= 14:00, start >= 9:00; Bob requires start >= 10:00 (and end <= 16:30 Tue/Thu, irrelevant given Alice's 14:00 cap); Carol unavailable 12:00-12:30 lunch, available 9-17. So search window each day is 10:00-14:00 excluding 12:00-12:30 and existing events.

Monday Jan 15: busy 10-11 (Alice), 11-12 (Bob/Carol), 12-12:30 (lunch), 13-14 (Alice/Bob). Free: 12:30-13:30 — valid, but Carol prefers to avoid Mondays (tie-breaker says prefer non-Monday slots).
Tuesday Jan 16: busy 10-12 (Alice), 12-12:30 (lunch), 13-14 (Bob/Carol). Free only 12:30-13:00 (30 min) — no valid 1-hour slot.
Wednesday Jan 17: busy 10-11 (Alice), 12-13 (Bob/Carol + lunch), 13-14 (Alice). Free: 11:00-12:00 — exactly 1 hour, valid, non-Monday, and within Alice's preferred morning window.

So the chosen slot is Wednesday 2024-01-17 11:00-12:00 UTC.
Plan: Write /app/meeting_scheduled.ics with a valid VCALENDAR containing the VEVENT for 20240117T110000Z-20240117T120000Z with all three attendees, then verify file contents and that inputs are untouched.
